title: Figure Split Tiles
description: Add a general mechanism so a figure disposition can split into many crop-tiles with independent positions across arrangements (reveal.js auto-animate). Demonstrate in projektetage: catalogue figure splits into 3x5 grid, taken apart/scaled down, partial focus.
summary: Fixed slide 7 (Bauteilkatalog) and all interactive split tiles showing the full catalogue in every cell. Root cause: `buildInteractiveSlideLayout` expands each split tile into its own disposition with `split: { tiles: [one] }`. A lone tile still satisfied `splitTilesPackedFrame`, so `FigureSplitMorphView` used assembled mode and rendered a full `` per cell instead of `FigureTileView` crop backgrounds. Fix: `splitTilesPackedFrame` returns null when fewer than two tiles; guard assembled rendering the same way. Tests updated (core + renderer). Verified in browser on #/1/0: crop fills use distinct positions (0%, 25%, 50%…), no assembled-full layer.
